papers.headline: A New Framework for Modeling Solar Flares from MHD to Kinetic Processes
papers.summary: Physical processes in solar flares span many orders of magnitude in spatiotemporal scales, so a single unified model accounting for all relevant processes remains computationally intractable.
papers.title: A New Framework for Modeling Solar Flares from MHD to Kinetic Processes

papers.headline: Strongly mixed cosmological collider at unequal sound speeds
papers.summary: We derive the canonically normalized modes of a two-field inflationary system with arbitrary constant quadratic mixing and unequal sound speeds c_varphi and c_σ for the curvature and isocurvature perturbations, respectively.
papers.title: Strongly mixed cosmological collider at unequal sound speeds
papers.authors: J. Huenupi, G. A. Palma, S. Sypsas

papers.headline: A comprehensive simulation framework for multi-modal kilonova observations from all-sky surveys
papers.summary: Current all-sky surveys such as Vera Rubin's Legacy Survey of Space and Time and the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) promise a wealth of scientific gains that are contained in the millions of astrophysical transient candidates produced each night.
papers.title: A comprehensive simulation framework for multi-modal kilonova observations from all-sky surveys
